run_split_data: run the script to split a data file into train, valid, and test sets using a power-law distribution
review_split_data_logic: review the power-law index selection logic that distributes validation and test samples across the dataset
summarize_split_data: summarize how the script reads a data file and writes train, valid, and test splits based on a given size
test_split_data_cli: test the split data script by providing a data file path and validation-test set size as CLI arguments
refactor_split_data_functions: refactor the split data script to extract the index generation and file writing into reusable functions
